title: Microsoft Fixes Nearly 1,100 Security Vulnerabilities
summary: Microsoft did another four-digit patch drop today, releasing updates to fix almost 1,100 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software. This month's Patch Tuesday addresses 63 critical flaws -- including a zero-day in Microsoft Outlook -- and comes amid important security updates from other software makers, includ...
advisory: Urgent: Patch edge devices and review perimeter telemetry immediately.
